{{Top|leg}}
'''Idol Smasher''' was developed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to be one of the strongest communications encryption systems created. Used to secure communications during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the Idol Smasher system was used by the Republic, the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], and the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], so that [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] major powers could coordinate efforts from their own systems, without being discovered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]
